title: Island getting wealthy from the AI rush
description:
Comment ISLAND and I'll send you the full breakdown. 👇

15,000 people. 2 letters. $85 million a year. 🏝️

In 1995, the .ai domain got handed to a tiny Caribbean island — Anguilla. For almost 30 years it meant nothing.

Then ChatGPT dropped, and every AI startup on earth wanted a .ai. Claude, Perplexity, x.ai — all of them.

At $140 per two-year registration and 2,000+ sign-ups a day, revenue went from under $3M a year to over $85M — nearly half the island's national budget.

The best part? They're spending it right: lower taxes, free healthcare for young kids, debt paid down, and a brand new airport.

An island that never wrote a line of AI code is getting rich off the AI boom.

#AItools #AI #startups #domains #anguilla #techbusiness #buildinpublic #ChatGPT #entrepreneurship #digitaleconomy
